en: A black‑and‑white waterfront cityscape showing a busy harbor or canal lined with multi‑story European townhouses and commercial buildings. Numerous sailing ships and small boats are moored along the quayside, with awnings over shopfronts at street level. In the distance to the left, an industrial skyline with chimneys is visible, along with a bridge and a small turreted structure in the water. The architecture appears late‑19th‑ to early‑20th‑century European. No clear caption or postcard markings are visible on the image itself.
